component.name: Wi-Fi Hotspot
component.summary: Native GNOME Shell Wi-Fi Hotspot with simultaneous AP+STA support

description.p: Share your Wi-Fi internet connection like in Windows 10/11 directly from GNOME Shell Quick Settings. Supports concurrent Wi-Fi reception and Access Point broadcasting (AP+STA mode), automatic 2.4GHz/5GHz band detection, and automatic firewall configuration.
